capabilities: Register vault images as stable CSS variables for use in background-image
Apply a vault image or remote URL as a canvas background layer with opacity, blend mode and layout controls
Add a theme-specific class to the top-level DOM for scoped theme override snippets
Auto-assign a CSS class to notes in folders matching configured path prefixes
Copy the current theme class or image variable via settings or a command
extras: Author solicits Ko-fi donations and links to their other plugins. Warns that remote background image URLs contact the image host and may disclose network request information. Includes a detailed theme-compatibility section naming specific themes that need selector adjustments.
intentEvidence: Add CSS that only applies to a specific theme, so you can patch/tune theme details without editing the theme's original CSS.
motivation: The author wrote it after trying around a hundred themes and wanting to tweak details; it grew out of a personal CST script meant to solve their own daily workflow first, then be shared.
problem: Vault resource URLs are regenerated on reload so local images cannot be used reliably in url(), and theme tweaks require editing theme files that updates can overwrite.

relations.evidence: If a theme supports Style Settings, great, use that first. If it does not, this module gives you a reliable fallback.

summary: CSS snippet helper that publishes vault image paths and the active theme as stable CSS variables and classes, with an optional canvas background-image layer.
